scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Lighthalzen Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to Einbroch, Juno and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇机场，
我们提供飞往艾音布罗克、朱诺和毁葛的直飞航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The boarding fee is
1,200 zeny, but you can
waive the fee if you redeem
a Free Ticket for Airship.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
登机费为1,200 Zeny，
但您可以使用飞空艇免费券来免除费用。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have 1,200 zeny to pay
for the boarding fee.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法支付1,200 Zeny的登船费。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
please come again.
Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
谢谢，
欢迎再次光临。
祝您有美好的一天~

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Lighthalzen Airport.
Please let me guide you to the
main terminal if you are arriving from your flight. Otherwise, please
board the departing Airship to reach your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇机场。
如果您是乘航班抵达，请让我带您前往主航站楼。
否则，请登上即将起飞的飞空艇前往您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if Lighthalzen is your intended destination. Shall we
proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
进入主航站楼后，
您仍需再次支付费用才能登上飞空艇。
只有当里希塔乐镇是您的目的地时，您才应该离开。我们要前往主航站楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
好的，感谢您的惠顾，
祝您旅途愉快~
